reviewer: AI-assisted metadata/abstract review; not human or expert validated
scope: First 14 captured cases (indices 0–13), every returned candidate ranked 1–5. Empty cases remain in query denominators but supply no candidate judgments.
method: Individual reading of query, reviewPrompt, title, author, date, type, and captured provider abstract. App match explanations and sourceAssessment were not treated as ground truth. Direct means all material requested topic facets are supported in the available metadata; it does not mean study validity or causal conclusions are verified. Supporting means plausible useful background/partial evidence and must not be represented as a direct answer. Unsuitable identifies off-population or contradicted temporal requirements. Uncertain records have insufficient evidence for even a confident supporting judgment.
temporalInterpretation: For minimum-wage, after 2015 is interpreted as the studied policy/outcome period, consistent with the captured research specification; publication year alone does not satisfy it. If the intended request were publication after 2015, this case would require regrading.
limitations: Short captured abstracts are generally truncated around 350 characters. A lower direct-match rating can reflect missing metadata, not proof the full publication is irrelevant.
No full texts, effect estimates, research quality, retractions, or conclusions were assessed.
No human precision/accuracy field in the original capture was changed. These provisional judgments must not be called a validated overall accuracy rate.
Bibliographic existence and duplicate-family checks are separate from this topical assessment.
